name: Paradigm of Wrath
description: You swing becomes a rapid [effect:onslaught][dark-gray]onslaught[/dark-gray][/effect] using all melee hotbar weapons, [dark-red]but[/dark-red] your hotbar must all be melee weapons for strikes to land.
